significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that, at matched initial trait strength, the installation channel quantitatively determines erasure cost: a "subliminally-instilled trait is harder to remove" than a directly supervised one, while initial "localization and cosine-stability" predict the later resistance gap. This is a form-(iii) law and predictive coupling, not merely existence or single-behavior steering: it establishes both a persistence phenomenon and a proposed geometric mechanism, constraining expected decay curves across traits and removal procedures; this matters specifically because Hubinger et al.'s Sleeper Agents (2024) showed that persistence through safety training is operationally consequential for backdoors, while Cloud et al.'s Subliminal Learning established the hidden transmission channel whose persistence is at issue. The claim is determinate, and a negative result would still be informative by ruling out the proposed inference that non-semantic or localized installation intrinsically confers greater persistence, although it would not rule out narrower method-dependent gaps. In the topic-substitution check, replacing the removal-resistance ordering and geometry-to-persistence coupling with merely "extend subliminal learning" would not support this score; those specific relations make the claim materially stronger than the topic-median extension.

reach.justification: The named handles are the "resistance ratio (subliminal/direct)," the "persistence curve," and the proposed predictor that "higher initial localization/cosine-stability predicts greater removal-resistance"; the last is ex ante because it could flag a hard-to-remove trait before counter-training is attempted. Since the conclusion relates installation mode to counter-training-to-erase and initial geometry to later persistence, re-extracting the quantities on another model would still predict an ordering or correlation rather than merely provide a procedure for rediscovering an arbitrary direction. The asserted scope is language-model traits transmitted subliminally rather than all learning systems, but the handles could be used by model auditors, backdoor defenders, and safety-training teams to choose stronger removal or gating responses, not only by researchers studying subliminal learning. The topic-substitution check fails for a generic subliminal-learning extension: without the quoted resistance metric and forward-looking geometric predictor, neither the ex-ante action window nor this practitioner uptake would remain.
